faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BRIC NBRC Project Technical Support-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Project Technical Support-I position at BRIC NBRC is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Bachelor's or Diploma, preferably with experience in medical record keeping, filing research files, documentation, and general office work. Knowledge of basic data handling and sample collection is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support-I position is 35 years. Age relaxation details, if any, would be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Technical Support-I position announced in this recruitment drive by the National Brain Research Centre.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the BRIC NBRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 200. This fee is payable as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support-I post will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-I position is a contractual job. The duration and terms of the contract will be specified in the official appointment letter.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Brain Research Centre located?
faq.answer: The National Brain Research Centre (BRIC NBRC) is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122052.

faq.question: Q10. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post. Download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.
